display_name: Larry Mulloy, NASA Marshall Solid Rocket Booster Project Manager

entries.body: NASA Marshall Space Flight Center (Level II management)
entries.role_detail: Participated in the L-1 teleconference on January 27, 1986; made the remark 'My God, Thiokol, when do you want me to launch, next April?' in response to Thiokol's initial recommendation against launch; received Thiokol's subsequent recommendation to proceed; did not escalate the engineering objections or the reversal to NASA Level II management or to Rockwell
